notes: The play button that waits over a stopped video is drawn for this tab: a frosted disc, a warm gradient triangle with soft corners and a slow ripple. The round button in the transport uses the same drawn triangle, so the tab reads as one control set.

Limits, stated plainly: a music video whose intro is longer than the song will still start a few seconds behind the words, because the picture follows the second the song is on and not the other way round. Nothing is downloaded and nothing is kept.
